name: Contractual Safeguard
oracle_text:
Addendum — If you cast this spell during your main phase, put a shield counter on a creature you control. (If it would be dealt damage or destroyed, remove a shield counter from it instead.)
Choose a kind of counter on a creature you control. Put a counter of that kind on each other creature you control.
blocked_sentences: Choose a kind of counter on a creature you control. Put a counter of that kind on each other creature you control.

needs.what: an op that has the controller choose a creature they control and one kind of counter present on it, binding both the kind (as a string usable by add_counters' `counter: {"binding": ...}`) and the chosen creature (so the follow-up add_counters can exclude it as "each other creature you control")
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_counters takes a printed counter kind, and its `counter: {binding}` form is only filled by a counter_placed trigger's event bindings; choose_permanents binds a permanent but no counter kind; choose_mode would need one mode per kind and cannot be restricted to kinds actually on a creature you control; proliferate/move_counters any_kind act on existing counters rather than putting a new one of a chosen kind on other creatures
